result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed; one notable issue is the heart/favorite icon inconsistency between cards.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icon on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a dark outline on a dark background overlay while the pizza card's heart icon has a solid dark circular background, creating inconsistent visual treatment between similar card elements.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent style (same background shape, opacity, and icon color) for the favorite icon across all promotional/restaurant cards.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant name is truncated with no ellipsis styling difference from other complete names, making it look like a rendering cutoff rather than intentional truncation.
issues.suggestion: Add explicit ellipsis truncation (…) or ensure enough width/line-wrap so names don't appear abruptly cut off within the visible card area.
